Definition
[steady breather definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 7.9\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals A steady breather is a Ricci flow on $[t_1,t_2]$ with $g(t_2)=\phi ^*g(t_1)$ for some $\phi \in \Diff (M)$.
